title: "Machine Learning"
toc: false
---

Models that predict the age of a home from public housing data. Each project builds on the one before it.

- [Classifying Home Age](Machine_Learning/project1.qmd): A decision tree that predicts whether a home was built before 1980.
- [Machine Learning Pt. 2](Machine_Learning/project2.qmd): The second unit in the sequence, linked from Google Drive.
- [Comparing Models](Machine_Learning/project3.qmd): Three classifiers compared, then a regression model that predicts the exact year a home was built.
